snippet.title: Town of Zoz | Release Window Reveal Trailer | Balor Games
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://balor.gg/TownOfZoz

A delicious new trailer for Town of Zoz reveals new cinematics, enemies, dungeons...and release window: EARLY 2026! Learn more about Ito, his journey back home to help with his family farm and restaurant, and the dark secret that haunts them all.
